title: audio_asset.allowed_uses.v1

render_safe.description: Must exactly equal audio_assets.render_safe; disagreement is rejected.

campaign_restriction.description: V1 automatic embedding requires null. Any non-null campaign-specific restriction is ineligible until a future approved deterministic evaluator exists.

license_evidence_required.description: When true, the relational audio asset version must carry both immutable license_evidence_object_key and license_evidence_sha256.

description: Frozen structured rights for an immutable audio_assets version. Automatic compensated HONOR embedding requires every V1 eligibility condition in x-honor-v1-automatic-embedding-contract; missing/false/unknown never grants use.

x-honor-v1-automatic-embedding-contract.license_evidence_required_rule: If true, immutable license_evidence_object_key and license_evidence_sha256 are both required.
